text:
Alex: FYI support ticket from AcmeCorp escalated — customers seeing intermittent 504s from hosted-infer around 22:10-22:40 UTC. They reproduced via SDK with batch=8. SLO p99 alert fired.

sre-bot: ALERT: hosted-infer.p99_latency > 1.0s for 30m on prod (route: /v1/generate). Incident ID INC-1423

Maya: link to dashboard: https://console.redwood/observability/dashboards/hosted-infer-latency

Liam: seeing a cluster of 504s correlated to long tail in the ingress service. quick query:

```
logs | where service=="ingress" and status==504 | summarize count() by upstream_service, bin(timestamp, 1m)
```

Liam: upstream_service shows mix of runtime-v2 and runtime-v2-quantized, but traces missing for many 504s.

Cleo: tracing gaps = suspicious. Jaeger sampling for ingress is 1% for production (default). If tail requests are sampled out we won't see root cause.

Alex: support says SDK shows "request timed out after 30s" and then server returns 504. Can we temporarily increase sampling for affected route and re-run repro with support?

Maya: I can flip sampling to 10% for /v1/generate on prod for 30m. Will also enable detailed request headers in logs (redact keys).

sre-bot: Action scheduled: set_trace_sampling(route=/v1/generate, rate=0.1) by maya at 22:55 UTC

Support-liz: I'll coordinate with AcmeCorp to run a reproducer at 23:05 UTC with the increased sampling. Their request pattern: 6 concurrent requests, each 8k tokens, one-off.

Liam: new query to look for KV cache misses + long first-token delays:

```
traces | where operation=="ingress.request" and duration>2000ms | project trace_id, span_tags, annotations
```

Liam: preliminary results show many long spans stall on "backend.kvcache.lookup" with lots of retries.

Cleo: That points to kvcache hotkey or backend overload. Check Redis cluster for spikes.

Alex: Redis metrics show CPU and avg latency spike on shard r-07 around the same timeframe. redis-ops alerted 22:08 but auto-recovered.

Maya: interesting — why would kvcache spikes produce missing spans? Our trace agent drops spans when parent span exceeds 25s or when sampling low. If many requests stall, p99 increases and sampled traces biased.

Liam: exactly — low sampling + tail amplification -> most problematic tails unsampled. That's why dashboard looked benign but customers saw timeouts.

Support-liz: repro started. They hit timeout at 23:06, I forwarded the request id: req_0a9f2c

Maya: got it, looking up trace for req_0a9f2c...

Maya: trace found — full span sequence: ingress.request -> authz -> kvcache.lookup -> runtime.call -> runtime.await -> upstream.timeout

Maya: kvcache.lookup had several retries (backoff) and a 2.4s aggregate stall, runtime.call queued due to backpressure.

Cleo: root cause hypothesis: transient Redis shard r-07 degraded causing kvcache retries; ingress saw increased queueing -> request tail -> SLO burn. Missing spans earlier due to low sampling.

Alex: mitigation done: (1) rerouted ~20% of kvcache traffic from r-07 to r-03 via shard remap; (2) temporarily increased trace sampling to 25% for route; (3) scheduled quickscale of runtime pool by +2 nodes.

sre-bot: Runbook note created: RB-1693 "ingress kvcache spike -> tail latency". Actions: reroute, scale runtime, increase sampling.

Liam: after reroute, 504s dropped within 3m. prod p99 back below SLO. Will monitor for recurrence.

Support-liz: AcmeCorp reports improved success at 23:15. They confirmed their SDK calls now consistently return.

Maya: follow-ups: need root cause on why r-07 degraded — correlates with nightly compaction job at 21:50 that overlapped with backup I/O. Opening infra ticket.

Cleo: long-term: increase kvcache circuit-breaker to fail-fast earlier and add per-shard QPS-based autoscaling. Also raise default trace sampling to 5% for critical routes so tails aren't entirely invisible.

Alex: create tasks:
- Liam: postmortem draft + log/traces links (due EOD)
- Maya: infra ticket for redis compaction overlap (assigned)
- Cleo: proposal for kvcache CB + autoscale (due 2w)
- Support-liz: customer follow-up + RCA template

Support-liz: will send customer note + next steps.

Alex: thanks all. Good cross-team move from support -> eng. Closing incident when postmortem published.

sre-bot: Incident INC-1423 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Close if no recurrence in 24h.
